positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
After three decades in designing software, I decided to take a sabbatical of undermined duration--the term "retirement" has a sense of finality that does not resonate with me just yet. I wanted to purse another longtime passion of mine: photography.

As a photographer with the mind of an engineer, I am never afraid of experimenting, and I leave very little to chance. I don't take photos, I make them. But I don't make them alone. It is always a collaborative effort. This is why I love working with people, and dancers in particular. They have perfect control of movement and don't leave anything to chance either.

Dance is the combination of music and movement. Photography captures neither, so is it not a disservice to dance? The answer is no, because dance photography is a very different medium. The moment before the shutter opens and the moment after it closes are not captured. This enables new movements, that often cannot be inserted in a choreography aimed at an audience.

With this freedom in mind, I work with choreographers and dancers to conceptualize and create images that represent who they are or what they have to say.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Consumer Robotics
positions.description: Worked on the mobility layer of the Astro home robot, so it reacts to environmental changes and behaves naturally to create an emotional bond with people in the home. Architected tooling for the 3D data visualization.
positions.insights: C++, Robot Operating System (ROS) and +4 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, IoT
positions.description: Created a resilient peer-to-peer network over a variety of transports for IoT communication for Alexa devices.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Fire TV
positions.description: Shipped Amazon FireTV, the first video streaming device that would start playing within half a second of the user pressing the button.

positions.title: Software Architecture, Distinguished engineer, Music BU
positions.description: Responsible for the Squeezebox system architecture; encompassing mobile, server and embedded teams.

positions.title: Software Architecture, Distinguished Engineer, Digital Home Group
positions.description:
Led the software application teams through the development of Logitech Revue with Harmony control and a DLNA player on GoogleTV, an iOS and an Android mobile apps, as well as the support from the Harmony web services. Managed all dependencies in the product backlog, which resulted in the shipping within 18 months of a new and complex product with a team assembled from scratch.

Created the system design for embedding cross-platform infrared control logic into OEM consumer electronic devices with a platform specific User Interface.
Launched an intranet site for sharing best practices cross-sites and cross-BUs.

Directed the technical feasibility analysis for new ideas during the portfolio renewal process as well as for external partnerships. Represented the BU on the corporate patent steering committee.

positions.title: Software Architect, Remote Controls
positions.description:
Created the software design and guidance for a rewrite of the back-end services for Harmony universal remote control applications using the .Net stack (MS-SQL, EF, WCF, Silverlight).

Spearheaded Scrum methodologies for leading the teams through its implementation.
